description: GNSSnet.hu is the active GNSS reference station network of Hungary, maintained by the GNSS Service Centre of the Satellite Geodetic Observatory at the Lechner Knowledge Centre. The centre has provided network RTK corrections for satellite positioning across the whole country since 2008. Its services are real-time RTK and network RTK corrections at centimetre accuracy, real-time DGNSS corrections at decimetre accuracy, download of RINEX and virtual RINEX data, and precision agriculture services, and the site publishes monthly availability values, maintenance notices, station descriptions and quality checks. For post-processing, registered users can download RINEX observations of the reference stations, or data computed for virtual stations at a place they choose, online for the past 30 days, in the ETRS89 reference frame; the page says 1 to 3 cm accuracy is reachable with 10 to 30 minutes of observation. Access needs registration, and the services are sold under current offers and general terms; no open licence is stated. Caveats: the site is in Hungarian and the online archive goes back only 30 days. Coverage is Hungary. It supports positioning infrastructure studies, crustal deformation monitoring and space weather effects on GNSS; related records are CZEPOS of the Czech Republic and ASG-EUPOS of Poland.
